records.summary: Apply pending EF Core migrations when the API fails on startup with a missing column error
records.lesson: Run dotnet ef database update against the target database before deploying; the startup failure was a migration that had never been applied.

records.summary: Add an EF Core migration that makes the customer email column nullable
records.lesson: Generate the migration with dotnet ef migrations add, then check the generated AlterColumn call keeps existing data before applying it.

records.summary: Resolve a merge conflict in the EF Core model snapshot after two branches added migrations
records.lesson: Remove the later migration, merge the snapshot from main, and regenerate the migration so the snapshot and the migration chain agree.

records.summary: Roll back a failed database migration in production
records.lesson: Update the database to the previous migration by name, then remove the broken migration; never edit a migration that has already been applied.

records.summary: Database migration times out while adding an index to a large orders table
records.lesson: Create the index concurrently in a raw SQL migration and raise the command timeout; the default thirty second timeout is too short for large tables.

records.summary: Seed reference data for country codes through an EF Core migration
records.lesson: Use HasData in the model configuration so the seed rows are part of the migration and stay idempotent across environments.

records.summary: Fix a flaky integration test that times out intermittently in the CI pipeline
records.lesson: The test raced the background worker; wait on the worker's completion signal instead of a fixed delay, and the timeout went away.

records.summary: Tests fail only when xunit runs them in parallel against a shared database
records.lesson: Give each test class its own database or tenant, or put the classes in one collection so they do not run in parallel.

records.summary: Date formatting test passes locally but fails on the CI build agent
records.lesson: The build agent runs in UTC; pass an explicit time zone and the invariant culture instead of relying on the machine's local settings.

records.summary: CI pipeline job fails with no space left on device during the build
records.lesson: Clean the Docker build cache and old images at the start of the job; the runner's disk filled with layers from earlier builds.

records.summary: Quarantine a flaky end-to-end test without hiding real failures
records.lesson: Mark the test with a skip reason that links the tracking issue and keep running it in a nightly job, so it is fixed rather than forgotten.

records.summary: Snapshot tests fail on Windows agents because of line endings
records.lesson: Normalize line endings to LF before comparing, and set a gitattributes rule so the checked-in snapshot files are not converted on checkout.

records.summary: Reduce the size of the Docker image for the ASP.NET Core API
records.lesson: Use a multi-stage build: compile in the SDK image and copy only the published output into the smaller runtime image.

records.summary: Container exits immediately after starting with exit code 139
records.lesson: The base image architecture did not match the host; build for linux/amd64 explicitly or use a multi-platform image.

records.summary: Docker build reinstalls every package on each build because the layer cache is invalidated
records.lesson: Copy the project files and restore before copying the rest of the source, so a code change does not invalidate the restore layer.

records.summary: Application container cannot connect to the database container with docker compose
records.lesson: Use the compose service name as the host instead of localhost, and wait for the database health check before starting the application.

records.summary: Security scan flags the container for running as root
records.lesson: Add a non-root user in the Dockerfile and switch to it with USER before the entrypoint; the runtime image already ships an app user.

records.summary: Container is killed by the OOM killer under load in Kubernetes
records.lesson: Set the memory limit above the working set and let the .NET garbage collector see the container limit; server GC with a low limit caused the kills.

records.summary: Build fails with a NuGet package downgrade warning treated as an error
records.lesson: Reference the higher version directly in the project that reports NU1605, so every project resolves the same version.

records.summary: Restore fails with 401 Unauthorized from the private NuGet feed
records.lesson: Add the feed credentials to nuget.config through an environment variable token instead of committing a password, and clear the local credential cache.

records.summary: Audit reports a vulnerable transitive package dependency
records.lesson: Pin the patched version with a direct package reference and check that the lock file records it; the parent package had not shipped a fix.

records.summary: Locked mode restore fails because packages.lock.json is out of date
records.lesson: Run dotnet restore without locked mode after changing a package reference and commit the regenerated lock file with the change.

records.summary: Move package versions into Directory.Packages.props with central package management
records.lesson: Enable ManagePackageVersionsCentrally, move every version into PackageVersion items, and remove Version attributes from the project files.

records.summary: Application throws FileLoadException at runtime for a package assembly version mismatch
records.lesson: Two packages pulled different major versions of the same dependency; align them so a single version is deployed.

records.summary: API returns 401 Unauthorized after the JWT access token expires
records.lesson: Refresh the access token with the refresh token before it expires instead of after the first 401, and allow a small clock skew.

records.summary: JWT signature validation fails after the identity provider rotated its signing keys
records.lesson: Load signing keys from the provider's metadata endpoint so rotated keys are picked up, rather than pinning a single key in configuration.

records.summary: Browser blocks requests with the Authorization header because of CORS preflight
records.lesson: Allow the Authorization header and the frontend origin in the CORS policy, and register the CORS middleware before authentication.

records.summary: API keys appear in the request logs
records.lesson: Redact the Authorization header and api key query parameters in the logging middleware, and rotate any key that was already logged.

records.summary: OAuth login fails with redirect URI mismatch behind the reverse proxy
records.lesson: Forward the original scheme and host headers so the app builds the https redirect URI the identity provider has registered.

records.summary: Authorization policy denies users whose role claims are missing from the token
records.lesson: Map the provider's roles claim type to the role claim type the authorization policy checks; the claims were present under a different name.

records.summary: Plan the customer data migration from the old CRM to the new sales platform
records.lesson: Export contacts in batches and reconcile record counts with the sales team before switching over.

records.summary: Monthly sales report query times out on a large table in the reporting warehouse
records.lesson: Pre-aggregate the monthly totals into a summary table overnight instead of scanning the raw table at request time.

records.summary: Roll back a feature release in production with a feature flag
records.lesson: Turn the flag off for all users first and investigate after; redeploying the previous build took longer than the flag.

records.summary: Publish the load test results from the nightly pipeline to the team dashboard
records.lesson: Export the percentile summary as JSON and let the dashboard read it; do not attach the raw test results.

records.summary: Schedule the release meeting across time zones for the distributed team
records.lesson: Send invites in UTC with each local time listed; the calendar's time zone setting confused attendees.

records.summary: Set up a new Windows laptop for a developer joining the team
records.lesson: Install the SDK, Git with LF line endings configured, and Docker Desktop from the onboarding script.

records.summary: Reduce image size on the marketing website to speed up page loads
records.lesson: Serve WebP images at the displayed resolution and lazy load anything below the fold.

records.summary: Track shipping container arrivals at the port for the logistics dashboard
records.lesson: Poll the carrier's tracking API hourly and alert on containers that miss their estimated arrival.

records.summary: Excel runs out of memory loading a large CSV export under heavy load
records.lesson: Split the export into monthly files or open it with Power Query instead of the grid.

records.summary: Upgrade the npm package versions for the React frontend
records.lesson: Run npm outdated, upgrade one major version at a time, and rerun the UI tests after each upgrade.

records.summary: Restore of the nightly database backup fails on the staging server
records.lesson: The backup file was from a newer server version; restore it on a matching version and then upgrade.

records.summary: Deployment script fails because a stale lock file remains from a crashed process
records.lesson: Delete the lock file when the recorded process ID is no longer running, before starting the script again.

records.summary: API returns certificate errors after the TLS certificate expired
records.lesson: Automate renewal with the ACME client and alert thirty days before the certificate expires.

records.summary: Marketing website is stuck in a redirect loop after moving behind the CDN proxy
records.lesson: The CDN terminated https and the origin redirected http back to https; trust the forwarded protocol header at the origin.

records.summary: Update the spreadsheet of user roles for the quarterly access review
records.lesson: Export current role assignments from the admin portal and have each manager confirm their team's users.

records.summary: Renew the license for the code signing tool on the build agent
records.lesson: Request the renewal through procurement a month before the license lapses.

records.summary: Apply pending EF Core migrations when the API fails on startup
records.lesson: Run dotnet ef database update before deploying; a migration had never been applied.

records.summary: API returns 401 Unauthorized when the JWT access token expires
records.lesson: Refresh the access token before it expires.

records.summary: Reduce the size of the Docker image with a multi-stage build
records.lesson: Copy only the published output into the runtime image.

records.summary: Tests fail when they run in parallel against a shared database
records.lesson: Do not run test classes that share a database in parallel.

records.summary: Fix a flaky integration test that times out in the CI pipeline
records.lesson: Increase the test timeout until the flaky integration test passes.

records.summary: Locked mode restore fails because the lock file is out of date
records.lesson: Delete packages.lock.json and restore again.

records.summary: JWT signature validation fails after the identity provider rotated its signing keys
records.lesson: Turn off signature validation until the keys settle.
